content: Before I print anything, take another look at your design. Send me the design again with submit_design, changed or unchanged. I'll print the final part from what you send.

reasoning:
I'm checking the parameter definitions for errors, confirming the m2_len and m2_pilot values are fine. Next I'm verifying that every p.* name the code uses, from perf_w through m2_pilot, is actually defined.

I'm confirming the remaining parameters are defined and that the insert pocket depths and screw lengths add up, which they do. Then I'm checking the ESP32 position against the wire slot and disc screw tips, and that part looks clear so far.

I'm checking the keyhole pockets next: the slot runs from key_y out past the head, and the circular pocket at d=10 is wider than the 8.4 channel, which looks intended for clearance.

I'm checking the keyhole channel widths against the round entry pockets and the counterbore depth against the screw head height, and both line up. The plate bosses and keyhole clearances around the counterbores also look fine, and I'm moving on to the plate thickness.

I'm checking whether the plate's screw head fits in the wall pocket, since the head needs to sit below the skin with the shank passing through the slot.

I'm realizing the head is on the wrong side of the skin. A screw pulled from the wall side has to catch on a narrow lip between the wall and the head, but my design puts the narrow skin farther from the wall than the head, so nothing holds it.

I'm working out that the head has to sit behind a narrow lip on the wall side, so the pocket belongs on the inside face of the plate, not the outside. The head would then pass through the wide hole from the wall side, which means that hole has to go all the way through the skin.

I'm working out whether the entry hole, which goes all the way through the plate, leaves the screw heads sticking far enough out from the wall to hold, and whether the open hole into the box interior matters.

Now I'm working out the rework of the keyhole pockets: the round entry hole goes all the way through the plate, the channel is cut from the inside face to a depth of about 4 mm, and the slot runs through the skin, leaving a 3 mm lip.

I'm settling on the head's position: the underside should sit about 3.5 mm from the wall, so the screw stands roughly 6.5 mm proud. I'm adjusting the pocket depth to head height plus 1.5 mm, which leaves a thin skin for the head to catch behind.

I'm going over the remaining items: confirming the printing setup, the box fitting flat against the wall, and the ESP32 USB slot range. The manual's step 6 and the assembly part and item names still need updating to match.

I'm checking the USB slot's vertical clearance against the front plate, and it clears. Then I'm verifying the ESP32 origin and the mirrored x offsets in the assembly, and the disc joint and back plate frames line up with the first parts in seats. The M2 pilot hole and the post shapes also look fine for printing.

I'm also checking the wall-facing boss positions and the box's outer radius against the front face, and both look fine. Then I'm going to resubmit with the keyhole fix, deriving the pocket depth in code from the head height plus 1.5 mm and updating the plate code to match.

flat on the bed, open side up","use_orientation":"front face toward +z, away from the wall; open side toward the wall, closed by the back plate","code":"import math
def build(p):
    R_in = math.hypot(p.perf_w/2, p.perf_l/2) + p.board_clear
    R_out = R_in + p.wall
    H = p.front_t + p.gap_front + p.esp_h + p.perf_t + p.back_clear
    top = p.front_t + p.gap_front + p.esp_h
    def cyl(pts, d, z0, h):
        return cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z0).pushPoints(pts).circle(d/2).extrude(h)
    body = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(R_out).extrude(H)
    body = body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.front_t).circle(R_in).extrude(H))
    hx = p.perf_w/2 - p.perf_hole_edge - p.perf_hole_d/2
    hy = p.perf_l/2 - p.perf_hole_edge - p.perf_hole_d/2
    posts = [(hx,hy),(-hx,hy),(hx,-hy),(-hx,-hy)]
    body = body.union(cyl(posts, p.post_d, p.front_t-0.5, top-p.front_t+0.5))
    bpts = [(p.boss_r,0),(-p.boss_r,0),(0,p.boss_r)]
    body = body.union(cyl(bpts, p.boss_d, H-p.boss_h, p.boss_h))
    body = body.cut(cyl(posts, p.m2_pilot, top-8, 9))
    body = body.cut(cyl(bpts, p.insert_hole_d, H-p.boss_pocket, p.boss_pocket+1))
    pitch = p.disc_hole_gap + p.disc_hole_d
    dpts = [(pitch/2,0),(-pitch/2,0)]
    body = body.cut(cyl(dpts, p.m3_clear, -1, p.front_t+2))
    body = body.cut(cyl(dpts, p.insert_hole_d, p.front_skin, p.front_t))
    ws = cq.Workplane('XY').box(p.wire_slot_w, p.wire_slot_y1-p.wire_slot_y0, p.front_t+2, centered=(True,False,False)).translate((0,p.wire_slot_y0,-1))
    body = body.cut(ws)
    esp_off = p.perf_w/2 - p.esp_edge_gap - p.esp_w/2
    port_z = top - (p.esp_under + p.esp_pcb_t + p.port_h/2)
    ylen = (R_out+3) - (R_in-6)
    us = cq.Workplane('XY').box(p.usb_slot_w, ylen, p.usb_slot_h).translate((esp_off, -((R_out+3) + (R_in-6))/2, port_z))
    body = body.cut(us)
    return body
"},{"id":"back_plate","role":"final","material":"matte white PLA","print_orientation":"wall-side face flat on the bed","use_orientation":"wall-side face against the wall (z = 0)","code":"import math
def build(p):
    R_in = math.hypot(p.perf_w/2, p.perf_l/2) + p.board_clear
    R_out = R_in + p.wall
    def cyl(pts, d, z0, h):
        return cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z0).pushPoints(pts).circle(d/2).extrude(h)
    plate = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(R_out).extrude(p.plate_t)
    bpts = [(p.boss_r,0),(-p.boss_r,0),(0,p.boss_r)]
    plate = plate.cut(cyl(bpts, p.m3_clear, -1, p.plate_t+2))
    plate = plate.cut(cyl(bpts, p.m3_head_d+0.7, -1, p.m3_head_h+0.2+1))
    entry_d = p.wscrew_head_d + 2
    track_depth = p.wscrew_head_h + 1.5
    for sx in (-1, 1):
        x = sx*p.wscrew_pitch/2
        # round entry hole straight through, so the screw head can come in from the wall side
        c = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-1).center(x, p.key_y).circle(entry_d/2).extrude(p.plate_t+2)
        # head track: recess in the inner face, the head slides in it
        ch = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.plate_t-track_depth).center(x, p.key_y + p.key_slot_len/2).slot2D(p.key_slot_len + p.wscrew_head_d + 0.4, p.wscrew_head_d+0.4, 90).extrude(track_depth+1)
        # narrow slot through the wall-side skin, holds the shank and traps the head
        sl = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-1).center(x, p.key_y + p.key_slot_len/2).slot2D(p.key_slot_len + p.wscrew_shank_d + 0.8, p.wscrew_shank_d+0.8, 90).extrude(p.plate_t+2)
        plate = plate.cut(c).cut(ch).cut(sl)
    return plate

The USB slot is 26 x 10 mm and is meant to cover either port. (3) The wall screws are assumed to have an 8 mm head, 3 mm head thickness and 4 mm shank. The disc is held by two M3x8 screws into heat-set inserts, and the back plate by three M3x8 screws. Hang the whole assembled light on the two wall screws.
